nom: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating and Brightening Daily Toner

segments.oily: Oily and acne-prone reviewers are split: some report increased oiliness and breakouts on first use, while others say it clears clogged pores, controls oil, and reduces buildup on an oily scalp.
segments.dry: Dry-skinned reviewers report both flaking, roughness and burning when used on the face, and, for a few, no dryness or irritation even with regular use.
segments.combination: Combination/semi-oily reviewers describe clearer, more even, brighter skin after about a week to ten days of facial use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided: many describe immediate burning, redness, or chemical-burn-like reactions on the face, while others with self-described sensitive skin report no irritation and even relief for reactive or bumpy skin.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (50s-60s) report softer, more radiant skin and smoother makeup application with regular use.
segments.normal: One reviewer without a history of sensitivity reports severe facial burning and redness after a single application.

concerns.aging: Mature-skin users report softer, more radiant skin and improved collagen-related texture; no dissent noted for this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it dries out skin causing flakiness and roughness, while a few with dry or very dry skin report no added dryness and even improved hydration when paired with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Most reports of redness are negative (immediate stinging, redness lasting hours after facial application), though one reviewer says it cleared redness and bumps within two days.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe compromised, reactive skin after use — chemical-burn sensations, persistent irritation after rinsing — with a smaller number reporting no barrier disruption despite reactive or sensitive skin.
concerns.spots: Widely reported to fade hyperpigmentation, dark spots, underarm/groin discoloration, and acne scars, usually after one to several weeks of use; no dissent found for this concern.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer pores, and reduced whiteheads/blackheads with regular use; a minority report worsened or new breakouts, including one describing worsened minor breakouts on the face.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report reduced oil and buildup on an oily scalp and general oil control on the face, but one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin says it made her skin more oily and triggered breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Burning or stinging on facial application
Odor control when used as deodorant substitute
Large bottle lasts a long time for the price
Underarm irritation or itching from use

extraits.titre: if you have oily skin, don't do it
extraits.texte: I have very oily, acne prone skin... this made me MORE OILY and broke me out! I have a whole bottle... its going kn the trash

This exfoliating toner is WAY too harsh for my fair, sensitive, so what pale skin. Applied via cotton round, IMMEDIATELY noticed redness and string stinging and burning. This persisted even aftet washing it off with cool water and a gentile, moosturizing clenser. Would absolutely not recommend for anyone with dry or skin the least bit sensitive! I was trying this out instead of ising their salicylic acid serum, which I like but was seeking something more effective to gently exfoliate; physical exfoliants are typically too harsh for my face.

extraits.titre: Burns sometimes but overall has helped acne
extraits.texte: I know people say it really burns their face and it definitely can burn mine a bit too, as I have pretty sensitive skin. But I still put it on every night after I shower and its helped me so much with acne. I would get lots of smaller white heads, and now since using it for a couple months I barley get any. So I would still reccomemd this product!

Skin type: Dry, sensitive Product: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution I bought this after seeing it everywhere—recommended by dermatologists and skincare professionals—and at this price point, it felt worth trying. It absolutely lives up to the hype. I don't use this as a facial toner. Instead, it's become a multi‑use workhorse for the body: Applied with a cotton pad to feet, knees, and elbows to help smooth dry, rough skin Let it absorb fully, then follow with a moisturizer Works extremely well for this purpose I also use it on underarms and the bikini area after waxing to help prevent ingrown hairs. Important note: I only apply it after all redness and irritation are gone (usually around day 3 post‑wax). It's effective, easy to use, and incredibly affordable for how many uses you get out of it—clearly a product that can stretch far beyond one intended purpose. As you can probably tell from how low my bottle is, a refill is already on my list. I know there are countless other ways to use this product, and I feel like I'm just getting started.

extraits.titre: Prevented ingrowns AND lightened acne scar dark spots!
extraits.texte: I began by using this after shaving in sensitive areas as I was prone to painful ingrowns/pimples if not. This (along with the fur oil) SAVED me and I have never had ingrowns ever since!! It has also made my sensitive areas lighter overtime! I then just began using it in my face care routine as a "serum" right after my typical toner but before my essence and it has 100% lightened my acne scar dark spots! I have acne-prone sensitive dry-learning combination skin that's typically very reactive to new products, but this did not cause me any harm. It did burn when applied over open acne sores, but that's expected.

This product is so amazing! I have extremely fair complexion and sensitive skin and it doesn't irritate me at all. It's even helping to remove the milia around my eyes and at the corners of my nose that I've had for years.Nothing works like this!

Just started using AHA and BHA's for my mature 59 yo skin. This AHA is of the smallest molecules meaning it is the most effective of all AHA's going deep into the skin. The next morning my skin is soft and radiant. Exactly what I need! Makeup goes on smooth and looks flawless. Highly recommend!
